label: How contamination happens
subgoals: Trace where the benchmark's problems and solutions are posted
Compare scores on the public set and on fresh equivalent problems
Check whether test designs appear in training under other settings

label: Detecting memorization
subgoals: Test verbatim completion of reference solutions from a prefix
Score the model on semantically equivalent rewrites
Treat overlap statistics as a screen rather than a verdict

label: Contamination-resistant practice
subgoals: Keep evaluation problems private and refresh them
Hold out a test set that tuning never touches
Evaluate on internal tasks before deployment
